g.text: Known usage is shown as a subtotal when incomplete; missing usage is never filled with zero.
800 actual attempts for 800 planned tasks. Below bars: known-field / actual attempts. * Hatched bars: known subtotal.
Dispatch limit 3 → 12 after 667 terminal tasks; 133 tasks remained. Six workers were never used.
Mixed dispatch phases: summed durations are not wall time or causal speedup. Billed cost: NA.
Subject tasks only; authoring, same-family review and management overhead are unknown and excluded.
